profile.title: Profile
profile.idHint: 6 to 20 characters, starting with a letter, using only letters, digits and underscores. You'll log in with the new ID afterwards.

adminEmail.title: Administrator email
adminEmail.explain: If you forget the password, the reset link is sent to this address.
adminEmail.sent: A confirmation email was sent to {{email}}. The new address takes effect once you open the link in it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.explain: When the page is in the background, new messages and friend requests show a system notification. This setting applies only to this browser on this device.
notifications.denied: The browser has blocked notifications for this site. To turn them on, open the site settings next to the address bar, allow notifications, then reload the page.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support system notifications.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.requirement: For Macs with Apple silicon (M series) only.
desktop.install: To install: open the downloaded file and drag VibeChat into Applications.
desktop.firstOpen: The first time you open it, macOS will say it can't be verified: go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway”.
desktop.update: To update: quit VibeChat, open the newly downloaded file, drag it into Applications and choose “Replace”.
desktop.prompt: VibeChat now has a Mac app: get your messages even with the window closed.
desktop.tooOld: {{feature}} needs version {{required}} or later of the desktop app. You have {{installed}}.
desktop.mustUpdate: This version of the desktop app ({{installed}}) can no longer be used. Please update to {{required}} or later.
desktop.noInstaller: There's no newer version to download yet. Please contact your administrator.
desktop.downloaded: Downloaded. Save it in the window that opened, then open it and follow the steps below.
desktop.downloadFailed: The download didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.only: You're only signed in on this device.
devices.confirmOneText: {{device}} will be signed out right away and will need to sign in again.
devices.confirmOthersText: You'll be signed out right away everywhere except on this device.
devices.done: That device has been signed out
